author: kelmruns
seen: A 9-second vertical reel of an AI-generated gym bro with a giant blonde two-foot quiff, swapped with Seedance 2.5 into crowded real-world clips (a cowboy bar, a bowling alley, riding a lawn mower) with a hype soundtrack. The caption is one ego line: "ladies you all look lovely tonight, but i look better". The poster claims the 2-day-old account reached 26K followers and 2.2M likes in 48 hours and "$13,700 from one clip" (unverified; replies dispute monetisation). The character was generated in ChatGPT image; every shot keeps the same exaggerated silhouette so it reads on mute in half a second.
